source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != 0]
    colors = {v for _, _, v in cells}
    if len(colors) < 2:
        return out
    outer = max(colors, key=lambda v: sum(1 for _, _, x in cells if x == v))
    inner = next(v for v in colors if v != outer)
    outer_cells = [(r, c) for r, c, v in cells if v == outer]
    inner_cells = [(r, c) for r, c, v in cells if v == inner]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in outer_cells); r1 = max(r for r, c in outer_cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in outer_cells); c1 = max(c for r, c in outer_cells)
    ir0 = min(r for r, c in inner_cells); ir1 = max(r for r, c in inner_cells)
    ic0 = min(c for r, c in inner_cells); ic1 = max(c for r, c in inner_cells)
    thickness = min(ir0-r0, r1-ir1, ic0-c0, c1-ic1)
    for r in range(max(0, r0-thickness), min(len(out), r1+thickness+1)):
        for c in range(max(0, c0-thickness), min(len(out[0]), c1+thickness+1)):
            if r < r0 or r > r1 or c < c0 or c > c1:
                out[r][c] = inner
    return out
'''
